reviews.text: I really liked the quiet and calm atmosphere of the hotel. The staff were also very kind, so I was able to leave my cat there with peace of mind. I was also very happy when they showed me how the cat was doing on LINE. I was surprised at how relaxed my cat was when I went to pick him up. I hope to stay with you again if we have the opportunity. Thank you very much for your help this time.

Thank you for your review! We are truly happy that you were satisfied with our service. We will continue to strive to provide thorough support for the health of your beloved pet, so please feel free to contact us if you need anything.

Ideally, I'd like my cat to stay at home without changing her environment, but because I can't leave her alone with feeding, watering, and supervision, I was looking for a pet hotel. I felt confident leaving her in their care since it's a cat-only hotel.

The rooms are clean and tidy, and the staff, who are clearly very loving towards cats, handle everything, including feeding. I was also impressed by the thorough shampooing and grooming I requested; they even managed to remove the matted fur without cutting it!

I look forward to using their services again in the future.
Thank you so much for your kind review of our clinic! We will continue to strive to create a safe and secure environment for your beloved pet. We look forward to your continued patronage.
I was relieved to receive so many messages when I dropped off my pet. I'm glad I used their service. I will use it again.
Thank you very much for your review! We are very pleased to be able to provide you with a service that satisfies you. We look forward to seeing you again!
I felt reassured because I received daily updates on my health and videos of my daily life.

It was my first time, but the place was very clean and spacious, and the staff were very attentive and helpful, so I felt completely at ease.

Thank you as always. 
You've sent us lots of photos of him having fun playing with the staff and interacting with other cats (through the glass), which he doesn't usually get to see, so we can feel safe and secure while traveling!

I had been interested in this shop for a while, and when I inquired, their response was perfect, so I decided to use their services!

They carefully took notes of everything I told them, sent detailed and thorough progress reports with photos, and the staff were bright and kind, making me feel completely at ease leaving my pet with them.

This time it was just a one-night, two-day stay, but I would definitely use this shop again for longer-term pet care.

I'll definitely use them again!

He's not just kept in a cage, but also has "walks" (inside the room) like a dog, where he can move around freely and play, which I'm very happy about.
I feel very reassured when I receive reports on his daily progress, as well as a few photos and videos via LINE.
I'll definitely use your service again if I have the opportunity.
Thank you very much.

They are very kind and loving and keep in touch with me frequently, so I can leave my pet with them without worry. I look forward to working with them again in the future.

They sent me photos of their stay and were very polite in the communication from booking to pick-up, so I was able to use their service with peace of mind! I would definitely use their service again if I have the opportunity!

This was our first time using a pet hotel, and we were extremely satisfied with the kind and attentive service. Our cats loved it so much they didn't want to leave, and the daily reports were very comforting. We would love to use their services for the rest of our lives.

I made a request on the day, and they were happy to accommodate, which was very helpful.

I use this service regularly. They send me videos and photos of my child playing with toys every day, which gives me peace of mind.
It's easy to make reservations, and they always respond quickly, so I'm always grateful for their service.

The store is bright, stylish, and clean. My cat is shy, so it was great to have a private room where he couldn't see the other cats. The price is reasonable, and the ceramic food bowls are made by Tiffany! You can really feel the owner's dedication to his cats. I'd like to take care of my cat here from time to time, and hope to raise him to be as fluffy and gentle as the mascot cats. Thank you for your continued support!

I've used this hotel several times before.

The hotel is bright, clean, and very beautiful. All the staff were incredibly kind throughout, and the daily reports and photos they sent were so loving and I looked forward to them every day.

Compared to hotels with dogs, my cat seemed much calmer after returning home, so I felt completely at ease leaving her there.

I highly recommend this hotel!
The stairs are a bit tiring, but the hotel is friendly and clean.

I've stayed at this hotel several times.
It's clean, and they update me on my cat's condition via LINE, so I feel comfortable leaving my cat there.

However, I feel like the staff can be hit or miss. The other day, when I was leaving my cat there, a window in the building was left open. I asked them to close it, and they finally did, but I wonder what they would have done if the cat had jumped out the window. Cats can move in 3D, so it's unthinkable to leave a window open when leaving a cat there.

Ever since this incident, I've been worried about the safety of my cat. It's a shame because the other staff members were kind and I felt comfortable leaving my cat there.

Management, please make this improvement.

The sign said, "Please use the intercom if you need assistance," but I pressed the intercom several times and got no response. Finally, I knocked, and a staff member came out and glared at me with a sharp look. They're not suited for the service industry. It was a very unpleasant experience.

I wouldn't want to leave my pet in a place like this.
